title: Binary Trees
summary: Allocate and walk millions of short-lived binary trees (depth 14).
description: Builds a stretch tree, a long-lived tree and many short-lived perfect binary trees of increasing depth, counting nodes with a recursive check. Output is the benchmarks-game report lines.
reveals: Allocation rate, pointer chasing and garbage-collector behaviour.
caveat: Tree size, object layout and allocation lifetimes matter. C and Rust use plain malloc/Box (no arena); GC languages use their default collector. Peak memory differs widely by design.
